Position: Business Analyst

Position Summary
We are seeking a Business Analyst to join Innovata Consulting Group, an enterprise-focused analytics and operations consultancy serving financial services and retail clients. The Business Analyst will partner with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, Data Science and Client Services to translate business needs into data-driven solutions, build repeatable analytical assets, and support implementation of insights that drive measurable business outcomes. This is a hands-on role requiring strong SQL and Python skills to extract, transform and analyze data, produce reproducible analyses, and communicate results effectively to stakeholders. The role reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics and is part of a growing Delivery team delivering multi-quarter transformation programs.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering and Problem Framing
- Engage with stakeholders across Product, Sales, Operations and Finance to elicit business requirements, define success criteria, and prioritize use cases.
- Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems and specify data, metrics, and modeling approaches required to answer them.
- Facilitate workshops to align stakeholders on objectives, timelines, and implementation risks.

Data Acquisition, Preparation and Engineering
- Write efficient SQL to extract, validate and aggregate data from transactional warehouses and reporting marts.
- Develop reproducible ETL/ELT pipelines using Python to clean, transform and join disparate datasets for analysis.
- Document data lineage, definitions and assumptions to ensure transparency and governance of analytical deliverables.

Analysis, Modeling and Insight Generation
- Perform root-cause analyses, cohort analyses and ad-hoc investigations to identify drivers of business performance.
- Build analytical models and scoring logic in Python; validate model outputs and communicate limitations and uncertainties.
- Synthesize quantitative findings into clear, actionable recommendations tied to business KPIs.

Reporting, Visualization and Communication
- Create dashboards and visual summaries to monitor ongoing program performance and alert on deviations.
- Present findings and recommended actions to stakeholders and executive sponsors, translating technical details into business impact.
- Partner with engineers and product managers to operationalize insights into production workflows and feature specifications.

Project Delivery and Process Improvement
- Manage multiple parallel workstreams, deliverables and stakeholder communications to meet program timelines.
- Contribute to best practices, playbooks and reusable templates for analyses, data contracts and reporting.
- Mentor junior analysts and contribute to team knowledge sharing and code review processes.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 2-5 years

Technical Skills (required / mandatory)
- SQL
- Python

Other Professional Qualifications
- Proven experience working in cross-functional teams and delivering analytics-driven projects end-to-end.
- Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and ability to work independently.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders.
- Familiarity with data governance, data quality frameworks and basic software engineering practices (version control, modular code).

Preferred Qualifications (good-to-have)
- Statistics
- Tableau
- Experience in financial services, retail analytics, or consulting environments.
- Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) and orchestration tools.

Success Metrics
- Time-to-insight: average time from request to delivery for standard analytical requests reduced by X% relative to baseline within first 6 months.
- Accuracy and reproducibility: percentage of delivered analyses with documented data lineage and automated tests meets target threshold.
- Business impact: contributions to projects that achieve defined KPI improvements (e.g., revenue lift, cost reduction, retention increase) as agreed with stakeholders.
- Stakeholder satisfaction: average stakeholder satisfaction score above target for delivered engagements.
- Reusability: number of analytical assets (pipelines, dashboards, models) promoted to production or reused across engagements.

Location and Work Mode
- Hybrid: Delhi NCR, 3 days a week in the office.
